title: Aura Admin Dashboard Architecture Decision
context: The Admin Dashboard UI needs a modern, responsive Dark Glassmorphism interface. This ADR defines system boundaries, API validation, state routing guidelines, security/CORS controls, and asset upload limits to ensure reliability and consistency.

options_considered.option: Option A: Bare React state (`useState`) with inline styles.
Option B: Vite React SPA using path/query routing, centralized Vanilla CSS variables, and structured Hono.js/Zod validation.
pros: Enables deep-linking and browser navigation controls.
Consolidated styling utilizing storefront token overrides.
Strict input validation prevents malformed D1 database records.
Clear boundary separation between UI states and API data.

decision: Adopt Option B. Implement structural React SPA routing via query params (e.g. ?tab=orders) to enable browser back/forward controls. Style the UI using centralized Vanilla CSS variables. Enforce Zod payload validation in Hono, restrict file uploads to 5MB image assets, and wrap order refunds in D1 transactions.

positive: Consistent, high-performance user experience with native browser history.
Easily configurable layout variables matching the storefront's glassmorphism style.
Enhanced security against invalid payloads, shell injections, or oversize binary payloads.
Atomic transactional changes prevent partial failures during refund flows.
negative: Requires small additional routing logic setup in App.tsx compared to basic useState.

migration_plan: Incrementally replace inline styles in apps/admin-ui/src/App.tsx with semantic classes referencing variables in apps/admin-ui/src/App.css. Incorporate search-param checking for tab selection.
rollback_plan: If React routing fails, fallback to simple useState tab selection while preserving all styling rules.
